column1: # The detectors of drift quality check and drift quality coverage, one per line,
# fields separated by a tab: rule, violation, scope, mode, roots, globs, pattern.
# A dash fills an unused field.
# scope: code skips tests/ and langdrift/, all looks everywhere.
# mode: lines (each matching line), multiline (each match across lines),
# files (each file with a match), tracked (each tracked path the pattern
# matches), names (each tracked path whose name breaks the naming rule),
# markdown (each Markdown file without a type suffix), awk (each file the awk
# program named in pattern prints) and unmeasured (a rule file no detector
# covers; the violation says what does).
